optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Senior Channel Operations Analyst, Anti-Fraud Analytics Platform

professionalSummary.text: Senior analyst with 2.5 years of experience managing rule‑change intake, impact checks, release scheduling, and fraud steering committee reporting for a multi‑bank anti‑fraud platform.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran intake for rule‑change requests from three partner banks over two and a half years in the platform operations team, logging each request in the channel tracker, running the impact check against the last 30 days of screened transactions, and placing approved changes into the fortnightly release.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed intake and impact checks for rule‑change requests, ensuring accurate logging and timely release scheduling.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran intake for rule‑change requests from three partner banks over two and a half years in the platform operations team, logging each request in the channel tracker, running the impact check against the last 30 days of screened transactions, and placing approved changes into the fortnightly release.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared monthly channel reports for the fraud steering committee, covering request volumes, release contents, and open items.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly channel report for the fraud steering committee, covering request volumes, release contents and open items; the report was reviewed and presented by the head of platform operations.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored end‑of‑cycle notes documenting rule deferrals, reasons, and hand‑over contacts.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the end‑of‑cycle notes for each release, listing rules deferred to the next cycle, the reason for deferral and the hand‑over contact at each bank.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Anonymised channel tracker extract and end‑of‑cycle notes for two release cycles, demonstrating traceability and verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: an anonymised channel tracker extract (request id, bank, impact‑check result, release cycle, deferral reason) for two release cycles and the corresponding end‑of‑cycle notes, with the tracker's change history as a verification trail.

skills.text: ACAMS Foundations e‑learning completed; preparing for CAMS examination.
skills.witness: Completed the ACAMS foundations e-learning modules and am currently preparing for the CAMS examination scheduled for later this year.

skills.text: Senior‑level operational management, impact analysis, and reporting.
skills.witness: Responsibilities included request intake, impact checks, release scheduling and committee reporting for the rule‑review channel, working with two colleagues under the head of platform operations.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume, work sample, and reference notes establish the candidate’s senior‑level experience in rule‑change intake, impact checks, release scheduling, committee reporting, and preparation for CAMS certification, but do not confirm a five‑year tenure or completion of the CAMS exam.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate meets most role requirements but lacks evidence of five‑year tenure and CAMS certification completion.
